items.title: Fred Moore Interview, 1959-06-19
items.q: He had guys like, uh, Ward Pinky and Louis Medcalf and Henry Red Allen. All them boys. Used to help him out. Or we used to make, uh, sometimes we'd make about two or three playbacks.

ctx.x: When you smiling, how was Joe playing?

Well, he, he was playing fair. He'd always could play good, but his, he had that, uh, his teeth wouldn't let him play too high. See, his teeth, he had that, what you call it, a pair of red. A pair of red. On his teeth. And when he, during the time he was recording, he had different trumpet players. He had guys like, uh, Ward Pinky and Louis Medcalf and Henry Red Allen. All them boys. Used to help him out. Or we used to make, uh, sometimes we'd make about two or three playbacks. And the only reason why we'd make…
Where was Dave from? New Orleans.
